classification.difficultyReason: Directly restrict the numbered-marble set to each stated condition and count favourable members.

content.prompt: An urn contains 25 marbles numbered from 1 to 25. A marble is drawn from the urn. What is the probability that:

children.label: a
children.prompt: the marble numbered 3 is drawn given that it is odd?

answer.worked:
The restricted sample space is $\{1,3,5,\ldots,25\}$, containing 13 odd numbers. Only the marble numbered 3 is favourable.

$$P(3\mid\text{odd})=\frac{1}{13}.$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: a marble with a number less than 10 is drawn given that it is less than 20?

answer.worked:
The condition restricts the sample space to $\{1,2,\ldots,19\}$, containing 19 numbers. The favourable numbers are $1,2,\ldots,9$, so there are 9.

$$P(N<10\mid N<20)=\frac{9}{19}.$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: a marble with a number greater than 10 is drawn given that it is greater than 5?

answer.worked:
The restricted sample space contains the 20 numbers from 6 to 25. Of these, the 15 numbers from 11 to 25 are favourable.

$$\begin{aligned}P(N>10\mid N>5)&=\frac{15}{20}\\P(N>10\mid N>5)&=\frac{3}{4}.\end{aligned}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: a marble with a number greater than 10 is drawn given that it is less than 20?

answer.worked:
The restricted sample space contains the 19 numbers from 1 to 19. The favourable numbers are $11,12,\ldots,19$, so there are 9.

$$P(N>10\mid N<20)=\frac{9}{19}.$$

children.label: e
children.prompt: a marble with a number divisible by 10 is drawn given that it is divisible by 5?

answer.worked:
The restricted sample space is $\{5,10,15,20,25\}$. The favourable numbers are 10 and 20.

$$P(\text{divisible by }10\mid\text{divisible by }5)=\frac{2}{5}.$$
